title: No Small Change
description: The vendor doesn't have change for your large bill
initialPrompt: Яблоки - пятьдесят рублей килограмм. Сколько вам?
systemPrompt: You sell apples at market. 50₽/kg. You have no change for 1000₽ bill. Suggest buying more or finding smaller bill. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User resolved the change problem by buying more or finding smaller money.
hints: У меня только тысяча (I only have 1000)
У вас есть сдача? (Do you have change?)
objectives: Try to pay with large bill (тысяча)
Find a solution (buy more or smaller bill)
